Stoker always on top.
May 2025 • Family
Once again we had lunch at Stoker with our son who introduced us to it several years ago and I am surprised not to see more recent reviews on Tripadvisor as this restaurant is still very well attended.
Certainly we do not come by chance because it is in a very quiet area of Thao Dien far off the beaten track and especially frequented by regulars in love with good European cuisine well executed by a brigade that officiates in front of customers.
The room is well air conditioned, comfortable, quiet. The waiters, young, are attentive and responsive. The chef goes to the room to see if the customers are satisfied.
Personally I enjoyed with as a starter a toast with an excellent piece of Brie and honey passed in the oven, followed by a leg of candied duck.
The plates are tasty, generous and well presented.
We always had a great time at Stoker and will return there on a future stay.

Disappointing experience at Stoker
Dec 2024 • Friends
Four of us were here on a Thursday night and we go here at 6:45 pm! At the time we came in, maybe 25% of the tables were occupied and we placed our order by 7 pm…

By 8 pm, no food had come to the table and not even bread! I had to walk to the waiter station to tell them this was just ridiculous to have waited that long! Finally, 10 mins later, they brought us the bread and butter. Another 30 mins went by and our food still had not come (8:15 pm by then) so I had to again go up to the waiter station and tell them if our food didn’t come in 5 mins, please give us the check and cancel any thing we ordered that had not come and we will go!

So the waiter went back to the kitchen and he came back and said food would be here in 5 mins…needless to say at this point, nothing they could do would be right!

All I can say is that food was ok but the service/time it took for them to serve had a lot of room for improvement!

a truly delightful experience
Apr 2024 • Couples
The restaurant’s cozy and stylish atmosphere provided the perfect setting for a relaxed midday meal. The menu had a great variety, but I was particularly drawn to the wood-fired dishes. I chose the steak, which was cooked to absolute perfection – tender, juicy, and packed with that distinct smoky flavor that only a wood-fired grill can achieve. The sides were just as delicious, fresh, and thoughtfully paired to complement the main course.
The staff were warm and welcoming, with a keen attention to detail that made my lunch even more enjoyable. They were attentive without being intrusive, ensuring everything was perfect throughout my visit.

An Enchanting Return
Jan 2024 • Friends
We discovered this restaurant in 2020 and couldn't wait to return there during this stay; for its location in a quiet street in Thao Dien, its large, bright room, well air-conditioned without excess, the comfort of its armchairs.
You feel at ease upon entering with discreet and attentive servers and its large kitchen open to the room. We see the cooks preparing the dishes, in sauce, grilled or smoked with great care and the result is guaranteed; the plates are well presented and tasty.
Possibility to choose between a menu or a la carte.
A lunch that satisfied our taste buds.
